text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali asks Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to arrange better services for foreign investors.
- About 200 British travel agency representatives have gathered since Sunday in the Tunisian resort of Hammamet.
- Opposition party Democrats Socialist Movement to hold congress on 28-29 December.
- President Ben Ali visit to Germany last week: the two countries agree on a political partnership.
